mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (low unemployment) combined with strong employment growth (high payroll gains) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with CPIAUCSL rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 3.5%, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% annually while the federal funds rate remains below 1.15%, the market perceives delayed monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 1.15%), or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
